content_sections.heading: AWEIL Finance Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for AWEIL Finance Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification, experience and age requirements specified for the respective post. The Jr. Executive Finance Trainee post has 6 vacancies and the monthly consolidated emolument is ₹32,000. The maximum age limit is 25 years. Executive Finance Trainee recruitment includes 3 vacancies. Selected candidates will receive consolidated monthly emoluments of ₹60,000 and the maximum age limit is 27 years. Executive Finance posts require candidates to have CA/CMA qualification along with minimum post qualification experience. The recruitment notification mentions 9 vacancies with a monthly fixed emolument of ₹90,000.

content_sections.heading: AWEIL Finance Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process for AWEIL Finance Recruitment 2026 will be conducted through an interview by a duly constituted selection committee. Application Screening Shortlisting of Eligible Candidates Interview Document Verification The selection committee will shortlist candidates based on qualification details, percentage of marks, CA/CMA attempts and other prescribed criteria.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AWEIL Finance Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates interested in AWEIL Finance Recruitment 2026 need to submit the application form in hard copy. Download the prescribed application format from the AWEIL website. Fill in all required personal, educational and experience details. Attach self-attested copies of required certificates. Attach two recent passport-size photographs. Send the completed application through speed post/courier service. Director (HR) Advanced Weapons and Equipment India Limited Ordnance Factory Kanpur (OFC) Premises Kalpi Road, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh – 208009 The envelope should clearly mention the name of the post applied for. Only hard copy applications will be accepted.

faq.question: Q1. What is AWEIL Finance Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AWEIL Finance Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive by Advanced Weapons & Equipment India Limited for Executive Finance and Finance Trainee posts on contract basis.

faq.answer: A total of 18 vacancies are available across Executive Finance, Executive Finance Trainee and Jr. Executive Finance Trainee posts.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit varies from 25 years to 35 years depending on the post.

faq.answer: The salary ranges from ₹32,000 to ₹90,000 per month depending on the post.
